1: import {
2:   type AtRule,
3:   type Container,
4:   type Document,
5:   type PluginCreator,
6:   Rule,
7: } from 'postcss'
8: import selectorParser from 'postcss-selector-parser'
9: import { isString, makeMap } from '@vue/shared'
10: import { warn } from '../warn'
11: 
12: const animationNameRE = /^(-\w+-)?animation-name$/
13: const animationRE = /^(-\w+-)?animation$/
14: const isVendorKeyframes = makeMap(
15:   'keyframes,-webkit-keyframes,-moz-keyframes,-o-keyframes,-ms-keyframes',
16: )
17: const isWhitespaceNode = makeMap('rule,atrule')
18: 
19: const scopedPlugin: PluginCreator<string> = (id = '') => {
20:   const keyframes = Object.create(null)
21:   const shortId = id.replace(/^data-v-/, '')
22: 
23:   return {
24:     postcssPlugin: 'vue-sfc-scoped',
25:     Rule(rule) {
26:       processRule(id, rule)
27:     },
28:     AtRule(node) {
29:       if (
30:         /-?keyframes$/.test(node.name) &&
31:         !node.params.endsWith(`-${shortId}`)
32:       ) {
33:         // register keyframes
34:         keyframes[node.params] = node.params = node.params + '-' + shortId
35:       }
36:     },
37:     OnceExit(root) {
38:       if (Object.keys(keyframes).length) {
39:         // If keyframes are found in this <style>, find and rewrite animation names
40:         // in declarations.
41:         // Caveat: this only works for keyframes and animation rules in the same
42:         // <style> element.
43:         // individual animation-name declaration
44:         root.walkDecls(decl => {
45:           if (animationNameRE.test(decl.prop)) {
46:             decl.value = decl.value
47:               .split(',')
48:               .map(v => keyframes[v.trim()] || v.trim())
49:               .join(',')
50:           }
51:           // shorthand
52:           if (animationRE.test(decl.prop)) {
53:             decl.value = decl.value
54:               .split(',')
55:               .map(v => {
56:                 const vals = v.trim().split(/\s+/)
57:                 const i = vals.findIndex(val => keyframes[val])
58:                 if (i !== -1) {
59:                   vals.splice(i, 1, keyframes[vals[i]])
60:                   return vals.join(' ')
61:                 } else {
62:                   return v
63:                 }
64:               })
65:               .join(',')
66:           }
67:         })
68:       }
69:     },
70:   }
71: }
72: 
73: const processedRules = new WeakSet<Rule>()
74: 
75: function processRule(id: string, rule: Rule) {
76:   if (
77:     processedRules.has(rule) ||
78:     (rule.parent &&
79:       rule.parent.type === 'atrule' &&
80:       (isVendorKeyframes((rule.parent as AtRule).name) ||
81:         /-?keyframes$/.test((rule.parent as AtRule).name)))
82:   ) {
83:     return
84:   }
85:   processedRules.add(rule)
86: 
87:   let deep = false
88:   let ancestor: Document | Container | undefined = rule.parent
89:   while (ancestor && ancestor.type !== 'root') {
90:     const ancestorDeep = (ancestor as any).__deep
91:     if (ancestorDeep) {
92:       deep = true
93:       break
94:     }
95:     ancestor = ancestor.parent
96:   }
97: 
98:   const rawScopeId = id
99:   let scopeId = rawScopeId
100:   if (!isString(scopeId)) {
101:     scopeId = ''
102:   }
103:   const shortScopeId = scopeId.replace(/^data-v-/, '')
104:   const longScopeId = shortScopeId ? `data-v-${shortScopeId}` : scopeId
105: 
106:   const nodesToNormalize: { type: string; raws: any }[] = []
107:   nodesToNormalize.push(rule)
108:   const childNodes = rule.nodes
109:   if (childNodes) {
110:     const childCount = childNodes.length
111:     let childIndex = 0
112:     while (childIndex < childCount) {
113:       nodesToNormalize.push(childNodes[childIndex])
114:       childIndex++
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:   const normalizeCount = nodesToNormalize.length
119:   for (let i = 0; i < normalizeCount; i++) {
120:     const node = nodesToNormalize[i]
121:     const nodeType = node.type
122:     if (isWhitespaceNode(nodeType)) {
123:       const nodeRaws = node.raws
124:       if (nodeRaws) {
125:         const beforeWhitespace = nodeRaws.before
126:         const afterWhitespace = nodeRaws.after
127:         if (beforeWhitespace) {
128:           nodeRaws.before = '\n'
129:         }
130:         if (afterWhitespace) {
131:           nodeRaws.after = '\n'
132:         }
133:       }
134:     }
135:   }
136: 
137:   const selectorSource = rule.selector
138:   const parser = selectorParser(selectorRoot => {
139:     selectorRoot.each(selector => {
140:       rewriteSelector(longScopeId, rule, selector, selectorRoot, deep)
141:     })
142:   })
143:   const rewrittenSelector = parser.processSync(selectorSource)
144:   rule.selector = rewrittenSelector
145: }
146: 
147: function rewriteSelector(
148:   id: string,
149:   rule: Rule,
150:   selector: selectorParser.Selector,
151:   selectorRoot: selectorParser.Root,
152:   deep: boolean,
153:   slotted = false,
154: ) {
155:   let node: selectorParser.Node | null = null
156:   let shouldInject = !deep
157:   // find the last child node to insert attribute selector
158:   selector.each(n => {
159:     // DEPRECATED ">>>" and "/deep/" combinator
160:     if (
161:       n.type === 'combinator' &&
162:       (n.value === '>>>' || n.value === '/deep/')
163:     ) {
164:       n.value = ' '
165:       n.spaces.before = n.spaces.after = ''
166:       warn(
167:         `the >>> and /deep/ combinators have been deprecated. ` +
168:           `Use :deep() instead.`,
169:       )
170:       return false
171:     }
172: 
173:     if (n.type === 'pseudo') {
174:       const { value } = n
175:       // deep: inject [id] attribute at the node before the ::v-deep
176:       // combinator.
177:       if (value === ':deep' || value === '::v-deep') {
178:         ;(rule as any).__deep = true
179:         if (n.nodes.length) {
180:           // .foo ::v-deep(.bar) -> .foo[xxxxxxx] .bar
181:           // replace the current node with ::v-deep's inner selector
182:           let last: selectorParser.Selector['nodes'][0] = n
183:           n.nodes[0].each(ss => {
184:             selector.insertAfter(last, ss)
185:             last = ss
186:           })
187:           // insert a space combinator before if it doesn't already have one
188:           const prev = selector.at(selector.index(n) - 1)
189:           if (!prev || !isSpaceCombinator(prev)) {
190:             selector.insertAfter(
191:               n,
192:               selectorParser.combinator({
193:                 value: ' ',
194:               }),
195:             )
196:           }
197:           selector.removeChild(n)
198:         } else {
199:           // DEPRECATED usage
200:           // .foo ::v-deep .bar -> .foo[xxxxxxx] .bar
201:           warn(
202:             `${value} usage as a combinator has been deprecated. ` +
203:               `Use :deep(<inner-selector>) instead of ${value} <inner-selector>.`,
204:           )
205: 
206:           const prev = selector.at(selector.index(n) - 1)
207:           if (prev && isSpaceCombinator(prev)) {
208:             selector.removeChild(prev)
209:           }
210:           selector.removeChild(n)
211:         }
212:         return false
213:       }
214: 
215:       // slot: use selector inside `::v-slotted` and inject [id + '-s']
216:       // instead.
217:       // ::v-slotted(.foo) -> .foo[xxxxxxx-s]
218:       if (value === ':slotted' || value === '::v-slotted') {
219:         rewriteSelector(
220:           id,
221:           rule,
222:           n.nodes[0],
223:           selectorRoot,
224:           deep,
225:           true /* slotted */,
226:         )
227:         let last: selectorParser.Selector['nodes'][0] = n
228:         n.nodes[0].each(ss => {
229:           selector.insertAfter(last, ss)
230:           last = ss
231:         })
232:         // selector.insertAfter(n, n.nodes[0])
233:         selector.removeChild(n)
234:         // since slotted attribute already scopes the selector there's no
235:         // need for the non-slot attribute.
236:         shouldInject = false
237:         return false
238:       }
239: 
240:       // global: replace with inner selector and do not inject [id].
241:       // ::v-global(.foo) -> .foo
242:       if (value === ':global' || value === '::v-global') {
243:         selectorRoot.insertAfter(selector, n.nodes[0])
244:         selectorRoot.removeChild(selector)
245:         return false
246:       }
247:     }
248: 
249:     if (n.type === 'universal') {
250:       const prev = selector.at(selector.index(n) - 1)
251:       const next = selector.at(selector.index(n) + 1)
252:       // * ... {}
253:       if (!prev) {
254:         // * .foo {} -> .foo[xxxxxxx] {}
255:         if (next) {
256:           if (next.type === 'combinator' && next.value === ' ') {
257:             selector.removeChild(next)
258:           }
259:           selector.removeChild(n)
260:           return
261:         } else {
262:           // * {} -> [xxxxxxx] {}
263:           node = selectorParser.combinator({
264:             value: '',
265:           })
266:           selector.insertBefore(n, node)
267:           selector.removeChild(n)
268:           return false
269:         }
270:       }
271:       // .foo * -> .foo[xxxxxxx] *
272:       if (node) return
273:     }
274: 
275:     if (
276:       (n.type !== 'pseudo' && n.type !== 'combinator') ||
277:       (n.type === 'pseudo' &&
278:         (n.value === ':is' || n.value === ':where') &&
279:         !node)
280:     ) {
281:       node = n
282:     }
283:   })
284: 
285:   if (rule.nodes.some(node => node.type === 'rule')) {
286:     const deep = (rule as any).__deep
287:     const decls = rule.nodes.filter(node => node.type === 'decl')
288:     if (!deep && decls.length) {
289:       for (const decl of decls) {
290:         rule.removeChild(decl)
291:       }
292:       const hostRule = new Rule({
293:         nodes: decls,
294:         selector: '&',
295:       })
296:       rule.prepend(hostRule)
297:     }
298:     shouldInject = deep
299:   }
300: 
301:   if (node) {
302:     const { type, value } = node as selectorParser.Node
303:     if (type === 'pseudo' && (value === ':is' || value === ':where')) {
304:       ;(node as selectorParser.Pseudo).nodes.forEach(value =>
305:         rewriteSelector(id, rule, value, selectorRoot, deep, slotted),
306:       )
307:       shouldInject = false
308:     }
309:   }
310: 
311:   if (node) {
312:     ;(node as selectorParser.Node).spaces.after = ''
313:   } else {
314:     // For deep selectors & standalone pseudo selectors,
315:     // the attribute selectors are prepended rather than appended.
316:     // So all leading spaces must be eliminated to avoid problems.
317:     selector.first.spaces.before = ''
318:   }
319: 
320:   if (shouldInject) {
321:     const idToAdd = slotted ? id + '-s' : id
322:     selector.insertAfter(
323:       // If node is null it means we need to inject [id] at the start
324:       // insertAfter can handle `null` here
325:       node as any,
326:       selectorParser.attribute({
327:         attribute: idToAdd,
328:         value: idToAdd,
329:         raws: {},
330:         quoteMark: `"`,
331:       }),
332:     )
333:   }
334: }
335: 
336: function isSpaceCombinator(node: selectorParser.Node) {
337:   return node.type === 'combinator' && /^\s+$/.test(node.value)
338: }

341: export default scopedPlugin
